payload.subject: Re: Expansion to EU teams
payload.body_text:
Hi Dana,
Legal is fine with the order form. One more step before signature: because the EU rollout moves warehouse data for our EU entity, our Head of Security, Marco Ruiz, has to sign off on the vendor. I've added him to Thursday's call. Budget is still approved, and I'm still your point of contact on the commercial side.
Priya
